_meta.scope: Type G checks on prompts/verify-a-claims.json: 16 opportunities.json tracker rows, 18 vendors.json milestones, and 6 news.json Janus items.
angles_run: Army Janus: army.mil 294891 (2026-08-26) plus each of the 5 vendors' own releases (Antares, Radiant, BWXT, General Atomics, Westinghouse) and DIU coverage, for executed-vs-selected status
Radiant Kaleidos DOME criticality / 150h run status vs the Q3 2026 target
DOE Reactor Pilot Program criticality count (5 vs more) through 2026-09-26
Eielson NOITA-to-contract progress and any 2026 NRC/DAF milestone
ANPI JBSA/Buckley/Malmstrom status since the 2026-04-22/23 selections
Equinix-Radiant, Oklo-Switch, IANC, NANO-Supermicro, Texas Backup Power, UK Last Energy/DP World, Canada SRC, Romania Doicesti, US-Japan-Korea MOC
Vendor milestone dates: Centrus HALEU contracts (Antares, Radiant), Antares Series C and CNO hire, Westinghouse eVinci NCERC criticality (Aug 24, Sep 3), Valar/Aalo/Oklo criticality site attribution
absences: Did not independently re-verify vendor 'target' (not-yet-due) milestones beyond their parent opportunity row: Antares R1-to-JBSA 2028, the 2030 ANPI operating goal at all three bases, Radiant/Westinghouse DOME-linked 2028 FOAK dates, Malmstrom 2030, BWXT early-2030s operation — none have come due as of 2026-09-26 so none can yet be scored met/missed.

Did not re-check Westinghouse's 2025-02-17 Penn State NRC notice-of-intent milestone (old, stable filing) or reconcile the exact '11 projects from 10 companies' DOE Reactor Pilot Program roster count against DOE's full project list.

Could not obtain per-vendor Janus OTA dollar figures beyond Radiant's disclosed up-to-$750M ceiling; the Army has declined to disclose the other four, and this was not re-attempted a third time per the bail rule.

businesswire.com blocked WebFetch (403) on most of its own releases; relied on syndicated mirrors (Yahoo Finance, TechCrunch, norfolkdailynews, SEC 8-K exhibits, neutronbytes) which carried the same text.

eielson.af.mil, af.mil and safie.hq.af.mil all blocked WebFetch (403/cert mismatch); Eielson status leans on Oklo's own release, POWER magazine and Murkowski's office instead of the base's own article.

checks.claim: Five of nine sites matched to vendors, up to $2.2bn across FY2027-FY2031; agreements are fixed-price milestone-based Other Transaction Authority awards and none has been recorded as executed
checks.evidence: The Army's own 2026-08-26 release (army.mil 294891) says the Army 'down-selected potential industry awardees for negotiation' of the OTAs, not signed them. Four of five vendors' own releases (Antares, BWXT, General Atomics, Westinghouse) independently use selection/award language consistent with that; only Radiant's own release claims an already-executed, binding $750M agreement (see check-army-janus-radiant-fort-benning-2026-08-26). No later report through 2026-09-26 shows the other four OTAs subsequently signed. This tracker row is accurate; contrast with 4 of the 6 news_janus items below, which overstate the same event as already signed.

checks.claim: timeline: Preliminary Design Review completed with UK ONR July 2025; target online 2030 (attached to 'DP World Thames Freeport — Last Energy PWR-20')
checks.evidence: The 2025 PDR is misattributed. ONR's own summary report says the review 'relates to the Llynfi site' and that Last Energy 'would instead apply directly for nuclear site licensing and environmental permitting for the Llynfi site in Wales' — South Wales, a separate project. A dedicated WNN article on 'regulatory progress for Last Energy's UK project' confirms the same: the PDR review concluded June 2025 for Llynfi, targeting a South Wales site-licence decision by December 2027. Coverage of the DP World/London Gateway project itself (Thames Freeport) describes only a commercial siting agreement and says Last Energy is separately 'developing reactors in South Wales where the Office for Nuclear Regulation is conducting nuclear site licensing' — i.e. the regulatory progress belongs to Llynfi, not to DP World Thames Freeport. The 2030 online target itself is unchanged.
checks.correction: No PDR here — that was South Wales's. Target online 2030.
